title: Record slide decisions and item discussion without a pull-request verdict
preconditions: A live review has multiple slides, addressable Items, and an authenticated reviewer seat.

steps.action: Approve one slide, request changes on another, and clear a prior decision.
steps.expected_result: Each append-only decision targets only its slide and records the reviewed head and reviewer identity.

steps.action: Comment on a slide Item, reply, and resolve the thread.
steps.expected_result: The discussion remains attached to that slide or Item and its open-thread count updates.

steps.action: Attempt a decision without reviewer identity and a comment on Documentation or a missing target.
steps.expected_result: Each invalid write is rejected without creating a record or product-wide approval verdict.

expected_result: Pass when slide decisions and threaded comments remain scoped, append-only, and verdict-free; fail on an invalid write, lost reviewed head, or pull-request approval claim.
